summary: A protected original-coordinate 3x3 core is stable under arbitrary additions whose local principal footprint is below its singular gap, with density <=20/(kappa-delta). A protected weighted packet of 3x3 cross minors with I-side marginals h<3/4 is stable under arbitrary additions whose supported cross footprint is below the minor singular gap, with continuous density <=C(h)/(kappa-delta). This includes arbitrary-rank small dense tails and arbitrarily large signed eigenvalues with low certificate footprint.
volume_bound: C(h)/(kappa-delta_V), C(h)=6sqrt(e) for h<=1/2 and 6sqrt(e)(2h)^(-1/2)(3-4h)^(-1) for 1/2<=h<3/4

partner_result_applied.application: Uniform fixed-outside core density cap implies an L1_z(Linf_u) mixed norm cap; the theorem restores the actual dependent outside quadratic remainder with the same constant.
